Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New demo request: Acme Health — Redwood Inference

New inbound demo request via self-serve signup.

Lead details (submitted form):
- Name: Samir Gupta
- Title: Head of Platform
- Company: Acme Health
- Email: samir@acme-health.com
- Primary use case: Improving patient-facing summarization and clinical note generation; embeddings for search across EHR docs
- Approx projected monthly tokens: 50M–150M
- Timeline: Evaluation start in Q3 2025, production in Q4 2025
- Compliance: SOC 2 required; PHI considerations (on-prem or private deployment likely)

Next steps suggested by product: SDR outreach to qualify and schedule a 30–45m demo.

Attachment: acme_signup_details.json (form export stub)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@acme-health.com>
Cc: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New demo request: Acme Health — Redwood Inference

Hi Samir — thanks for signing up and for the details in the form. I’m Marissa on the SDR team — I’ll help coordinate a tailored demo with an engineer and our Enterprise AE. A few quick qualification questions so we can make the demo relevant: 

1) Primary goal: Are you focused on generating clinical notes and summaries, or more on search/embeddings across records (or both)?
2) Monthly volume: you noted 50M–150M tokens — is that peak expected with burst, or steady-state? Any estimate for concurrent requests/users?
3) Timeline and decision process: who else on your side is involved in the evaluation and what is your target decision date?
4) Compliance & data flow: will you need us to run in a VPC/on-prem and avoid any hosted inference for PHI?
5) Who would join the demo from Acme (roles)? You mentioned engineering — can you confirm names/emails?

We can run a 30–45 minute demo focused on architecture, cost/latency tradeoffs, and compliance options. Here are a few times I have available — or feel free to pick directly: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-30
- Wed 6/18, 10:00–10:45 AM PT
- Wed 6/18, 1:30–2:15 PM PT
- Thu 6/19, 2:00–2:45 PM PT

I’ve cc’d Evelyn (our AE) to join once we confirm scope.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Sales Development Representative
Redwood Inference
From: Samir Gupta <samir@acme-health.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New demo request: Acme Health — Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa — great, appreciate the quick reply. Answers below: 

1) Primary goal: Both. Our immediate need is generating structured visit summaries (clinical note condensation from provider notes) and surfacing patient records with semantic search. We expect to start with summarization and add embeddings/search in phase 2.
2) Monthly volume: 50M tokens is our conservative steady-state; peak could approach 150M depending on rollout. Concurrent requests: ~20–50 concurrent inference streams at peak (multiple providers).
3) Timeline/process: Evaluation begins July; decision targeted by end of Q3. Key stakeholders: me (Head of Platform), Priya Shah (Engineering Lead, priya@acme-health.com), and our Security/Compliance lead (TBD).
4) Compliance: We handle PHI; preference is private deployment (VPC or on-prem) with KMS integration. SOC 2 is required.
5) Attendees: Myself and Priya for the initial call; we may loop in compliance later.

Any of the times you proposed work except Wed morning. Can we do Wed 6/18 1:30–2:15 PM PT? If that ends up not working, Thu 6/19 2:00–2:45 PM PT is fine.

I’m attaching a short doc with sample anonymized payloads and current throughput numbers.

Attachment: acme_product_requirements.pdf (redacted sample payloads)

Thanks,
Samir
Head of Platform, Acme Health

Cc: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai

- 5m intros & objectives
- 15m architecture & deployment options (hosted vs dedicated vs private/VPC)
- 10m demo: summarization pipeline + embeddings search sample
- 10m compliance & performance (SOC 2, PHI handling, KMS/HSM options)
- 5m next steps / mutual action plan

I attempted to book Wed 6/18 1:30–2:15 PM PT, but I have a calendar conflict — can we move to Thu 6/19 2:00–2:45 PM PT instead? If that works I’ll send the calendar invite (ics) and include Evelyn (AE) and Dev (Engineering lead on our side) to run the technical portion. 

Proposed meeting link & calendar: acme-demo.ics (attachment)
Agenda doc: acme_demo_agenda.pdf (attachment)

If Thu 6/19 at 2:00 PM PT is OK, I’ll lock it in. Otherwise, send a preferred time and I’ll try to accommodate.

—
